title: Foundation Extractor
summary: Extract team-level backend standards and reusable foundation modules from an existing repository without turning the source repository into the migration target. Use when the task is to identify which error, DDD, logging, API response, config, or runtime rules can become standalone foundation docs, adapters, templates, examples, or maintainer-only provenance.
draftHints: 按项目类型确认是否启用该 skill，并检查引用资料是否适配目标仓库。
sampleOutput: 可复用 skill 说明、触发条件、参考资料和运行边界。
